content: Yaatidi, gita maati de7iya hara kiitanchchoy saloppe wodhdhishin ta be7as. He kiitanchchuwa bonchchoy sa7a poo7isis.
He kiitanchchoy ba qaala dhoqqu oothidi,

content.text: Baabilooney tuna ayyaanati aqiya bessi gidasu.
tuna kafotinne do7ati shemppiya bessi gidasu.
Hiza, asa zerethi ubbaa ba laymatetha woyniya ushshasu.

content: Hessafe guye, ta saloppe hayssada yaagiya hara qaala si7as.

content.text: iya ekkanaw de7iya seera hintte ekkonna mela,
Hiza, I nagaray salo gakkanaw doorettis.
Iya immidayssa mela zaaridi iw immite.
Iya oothida oosuwas nam77u kushe iw zaarite.
Iya giigisida ushshaa bolla hintte nam77u kushe mathoya ushshaa I xuu7an kunthite.
Iya baw bonchchettidayssadanne iw injjetidayssa mela,
‘Taani kaweeda uttas; ta azini baynna maccas gidikke;
harggey, kayoynne koshi iyo issi gallas oykkana.
ays giikko, I bolla pirddiya Xoossay wolqqaama” yaagis.

content: “Iira laymatidayssatinne I miikkotethan de7ida, alamiya kawoti he katamiya xuugettin keyaa cuya be7ida wode iw waassidi yeekkana.
Entti he katamee waaya be7idi yayyida gisho, haakki eqqidi,

content.text: Neeni issi saate giddon ne pirdda ekkadasa’ yaagana.

content: “Entta markkabiya caanaa hizappe shammiya asi baynna gisho, sa7an de7iya zal77anchchoti he katamaas waassananne kayottana.
Entta worqqaa, biraa, bonchcho shuchchaa, inqo giya al77o shuchchaa, kaalose ma7o, liino ma7o, haare ma7o, zo7o ma7o, dumma dumma sawo mithaa, zaale, al77o mithaa, naase biraata, goole shuchchu,
qarafa, qimame, ixaane, karbbe, shitto, woyne, zayte, liiqo dhiille, gistte, mehe, dorsse, paraa, para gaare, aylletanne hara asata shammiya oonikka baawa.
“Zal77anchchoti maccaseekko, ‘Neeni amottida lo77obaa ubbay neeppe dhays. Ne aqoynne alleeqettidabaa ubbay neeppe haakkis. Neeni zaarada entta ubbaa demmaka’ yaagidosona.
He kataman zal77idi durettida zal77anchchoti I metuwa babbidi iippe haakkidi eqqana. Entti yeekkananne kayottana.

content.text: ‘Liino ma7o, kaalose ma7onne zo7o ma7o ma77ada,
worqqan, bonchcho shuchchaninne inqo giya al77o shuchchan alleeqettida,
Hayssa mela gita shalo ubbay issi saate giddon dhays’ yaagidosona.

content: Markkabiya laaggiya ubbay, markkabiyan biya ubbay, markkabiya bolla oothiya ubbaynne abban zal77iya ubbay haakki eqqidosona.
He katamiya xuugettin keyaa cuya be7ida wode, “Ha gita katamiw daaniya hara katami de7ishshaa?” yaagidosona.
Entti bantta huu7en baana qolidi, waassidosonanne kayottidosona.

content.text: he katamiya issi saaten dhayida gisho,
Xoossay hintte gisho I bolla pirddida gisho ufayttite.” yaagidosona.

content: Yaatin, mino kiitanchchoy woxa daaniya gita shuchchu denthidi abban holishe, “Gita katamiya Baabilooney wolqqan holettada hayssada kunddana; iya hachchife guye ubbaka benttuku.

Diithi diixeyssatinne yexeyssati, suusul77enne moyze punneyssati, hizappe guye ne giddon ubbaka si7ettokona. Ay kochcha zal77e zal77iya asikka ne giddon benttenna. Woxa girssi hizappe guye ne giddon si7ettenna.

xomppe poo7oy zaaridi ne giddon poo7enna. Machcho ekkeysinne azina geliyari qaali hizappe guye ne giddon si7ettenna. Ne zal77anchchoti biitta ubban erettida wolqqaamata. Ne bitan kawotethata ubbaa cimmadasa” yaagis.
Nabeta suuthay, geeshshata suuthaynne biitta bolla hayqqida asa ubbaa suuthay I giddon benttida gisho Baabilooney pirddettasu.
